name: Palm Video Studio
description: Generate short videos with sound locally with LTX-2.3. Write a shot, or animate a still from Palm Image Studio. Wide, cinema, vertical and square frames, two to five seconds, reproducible seeds, and a saved reel. Runs on this Mac with no subscription.

inputs.description: Optional still from Palm Image Studio, or any uploaded image, to animate

outputs.description: Locally generated MP4 clips with audio, saved with prompt and seed
